Message.Name: OUTRIGHT QUOTE MESSAGE
Message.Description: The Outright Quote message provides the price and aggregated volume for the best bid and best offer. Volumes aggregate quote and order interest. The message also indicates aggregated Customer volumes within the overall volumes.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of the symbol in the Series Index message

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of messages for the outright options symbol.

Field.Name: AskPrice
Field.Description: Best Ask price. To be used with the Price Scale Code from the Outright Index Mapping message.

Field.Name: BidPrice
Field.Description: Best Bid price. To be used with the Price Scale Code from the Outright Index Mapping message.

Field.Name: AskVolume
Field.Description: Total quantity available at the above Ask price.

Field.Name: BidVolume
Field.Description: Total quantity available at the above Bid price.

Field.Name: AskCustomerVolume
Field.Description: *Total quantity of customer orders at the Ask price.

Field.Name: BidCustomerVolume
Field.Description: *Total quantity of customer orders at the Bid price.

Field.Name: QuoteCondition
Field.Description: Quote condition values: 1-5

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Filler

Field.Name: Reserved 2
Field.Description: Filler

Message.Name: Outright Imbalance Message

Field.Description: Indicative opening price.

Field.Name: PairedQty
Field.Description: Paired off quantity at the indicative opening price

Message.Name: Outright Summary Message
Message.Description: The Outright summary message provides trading highlights of the day. It is sent out once at the end of the trading day as soon as a symbol closes.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of the symbol in the Series Index message

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of messages for the Outright options symbol.

Field.Name: HighPrice
Field.Description: Exchange high price of the symbol for the day. Use the Price Scale Code from the symbol index mapping message.

Field.Name: LowPrice
Field.Description: Exchange Low price of the symbol for the day. Use the Price Scale Code from the symbol index mapping message.

Field.Name: Open
Field.Description: Exchange Opening price of the symbol for the day. Use the Price Scale Code from the symbol index mapping message.

Field.Name: Close
Field.Description: Exchange Closing price of the symbol for the day. Use the Price Scale Code from the symbol index mapping message.

Field.Name: TotalVolume
Field.Description: Exchange cumulative volume for the symbol throughout the day.

Message.Name: Underlying Index Mapping Message

Field.Description: The unique ID of this underlying symbol in this market. This ID cannot be used to cross reference a security between markets.

Field.Name: UnderlyingSymbol
Field.Description: Full symbol in NYSE Symbology.
